prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted functional hints (photo quality, path helper, account security), select clean layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), and specific hotkey copy produced significant wins.
Harmful changes: Major structural overhauls (docking setup flow, split personality redesign), spotlight and split view layouts, account persistence hints, and certain copy changes caused severe performance drops or early test cutoffs.
No effect seen: Wait time, progress, and status indicators, background notifications, desktop prep or tutorial screens, and incentive badges repeatedly showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predictions (+8.0% or above) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or negative performance drops.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially desktop visibility/control flows, shortcut hotkey copy, summon flows, security hints, and story reordering—far exceeded low or negative predictions.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel Selection Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection interface to use a carousel layout with detailed companion trait cards. (why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion (64.2%). A carousel layout lets users browse options more visually and fluidly.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Companion Desktop Interaction Intro Screen: Adds a new screen at the end of onboarding explaining how to click, control, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support tickets show user confusion after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Identity Pet Restore Assurance Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing into an existing account recovers previous pets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with existing accounts.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Before Pick Friend Sequence Reorder: Reorders the sequence so sign-in occurs immediately before picking a friend. (why: Ensures user accounts and pet recovery identity are established before custom pet selection occurs.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Audio and Vocal Pet Feedback Flow: Adds a new audio feedback flow at the end of onboarding for users to preview sound cues and pet responses. (why: Introduces users to interactive desktop audio features early, addressing post-onboarding engagement drop-offs.)
5: [home, copy] Desktop Companion Visibility Quick Hint Copy: Updates the waiting screen body text to clearly explain where and when the pet will show up on the main screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported that pets do not show up on the desktop or users cannot find them.)
6: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a clear checklist layout comparing quick preset pets vs custom creation. (why: Choose path has a high mean time (514s); a checklist format clarifies option differences to speed up decisions.)
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Background Lighting Hint: Adds a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen advising users to pick bright, well-lit photos. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or generating unexpected visual glitches.)
8: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Summon Shortcut Intro Screen: Adds a screen right before completion introducing primary hotkeys for summoning and hiding the desktop pet. (why: Support complaints indicate users don't know how to hide or summon their companion after setup.)
